{{Top|leg}}
'''Lalos Island''' was an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It had gentle rolling hills and was the location of the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] owned by [[House Cadriaan]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
